evals.prompt: We're a team of 8 developers, releasing to production every 6-8 weeks. Every release is a stressful 2-day event involving 4 people manually running scripts. We often get hotfixes needed a day after release. Can you generate a facilitator chatbot setup we can use to help our team figure out how to improve?
evals.expected_output: A complete cd-facilitator-chatbot.md file with: (1) clear setup instructions for pasting the system prompt into any LLM, (2) a self-contained system prompt that includes the site structure from llms.txt, instructs the chatbot to ask diagnostic questions before advising, and references beyond.minimumcd.org pages, (3) a suggested opening message the team can paste.

assertions.text: Output file cd-facilitator-chatbot.md was created and is non-empty
The output contains at least one fenced code block (triple backtick) containing the system prompt so it is easy to copy
The system prompt contains at least 3 beyond.minimumcd.org URLs (evidence the llms.txt was fetched and embedded)
The system prompt explicitly instructs the chatbot to ask diagnostic questions before offering advice or recommendations
The setup/instructions section names at least 2 specific LLMs by name (e.g. Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini)
The output has three clearly labelled sections: setup instructions, system prompt, and suggested opening message

evals.prompt: Our CI pipeline takes 45 minutes to run and flakes on maybe 20% of runs. Devs have started ignoring test failures because 'it's probably just flake'. We're a 12-person team shipping maybe once a month. Generate a chatbot our team lead can use to run a workshop session to diagnose and address our delivery problems.
evals.expected_output: A complete cd-facilitator-chatbot.md file with: (1) setup instructions including instructions for at least 2 named LLMs, (2) a system prompt that embeds the site's page structure with URLs, includes diagnostic-first facilitation behavior, and references the symptoms/anti-patterns relevant to test problems, (3) a suggested opening message.

The system prompt explicitly instructs the chatbot to ask diagnostic questions before offering advice
